entities.summary: Ryan Lindgren is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the Seattle Kraken of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was picked in the second round of the 2016 NHL entry draft by the Boston Bruins, and has previously played in the NHL for the New York Rangers and Colorado Avalanche.
